title: NCERT Figure 6.3 - rotation about a fixed axis, shown by a ceiling fan (a) and a potter's wheel (b); only the fixed axis of each and the sense of rotation are redrawn.
unreadable: the ceiling fan of panel (a): four shaded blades, the hub and the down rod, drawn in 3-D perspective with grey gradient fills
the potter's wheel of panel (b): a shaded disc seen in perspective with a thrown pot standing on it, again all gradient fill and ellipse
with both bodies gone, the redraw is the two fixed axes and nothing else - this figure belongs to the class that should keep its scan
note: Both panels are shaded 3-D drawings and essentially nothing in them is a primitive this renderer has. What survives is the fixed axis of each panel, which is the one thing the figure is making a claim about, and the curled arrows that mark rotation about it. Each curl is an arc plus a straight head laid along the arc's own tangent at its end angle, not placed by eye. This spec is recorded so the figure's class is on the record; the card should go on showing the scan.
